projects.title: PNG Meter Reading Dashboard
projects.summary: A real-time dashboard for reading, monitoring, and analyzing png gas meter data.
projects.description: A client dashboard system that ingests png meter readings from hardware devices, visualizes consumption trends, manages customer records, and exposes an admin view for operations. Handles device sync, offline buffering, and multi-role access.

projects.title: PNG Meter Hardware
projects.summary: Hardware and firmware for reading png gas meter pulses and transmitting to the backend.
projects.description: Embedded firmware and wiring for reading png meter pulses, transmitting readings to the backend, and handling offline buffering. Includes calibration notes and device-to-server protocol.

projects.title: TextUtils
projects.summary: A Django-based text analysis tool with comprehensive text utilities.
projects.description: A Django-based text analysis tool with word count, character count, sentence analysis, and text utilities. Deployed on Render with a clean, responsive UI.

projects.title: Beautiful Task Manager
projects.summary: A beautiful task management app with real-time updates and authentication.
projects.description: A full-stack task management application built with React, Supabase, and Tailwind CSS. Features user authentication, real-time CRUD operations, task categorization, and a beautiful, responsive UI.

projects.title: Next.js Task Generation API
projects.summary: An AI-powered API for generating and suggesting tasks using Groq AI.
projects.description: A Next.js API backend that leverages Groq AI to generate, suggest, and optimize tasks from user input. Designed for seamless frontend integration with low latency and high accuracy.

projects.title: Milk Delivery System
projects.summary: A full-stack milk delivery platform with admin and partner dashboards.
projects.description: A complete e-commerce platform for milk delivery with separate dashboards for admin, partners, and customers. Features order management, real-time delivery tracking, user authentication, payment integration, and analytics.

projects.title: Around The World
projects.summary: A React travel discovery app with filtering, search, and detailed place information.
projects.description: An interactive travel discovery application built with React. Features advanced filtering, location search, detailed place information cards, responsive design, and integration with travel APIs.

projects.title: Backend Hub
projects.summary: A serverless backend hub exposing multiple APIs for personal projects.
projects.description: A collection of production-ready APIs built with serverless architecture. Includes task generation, user management, data processing, and utility endpoints. Deployed on Vercel with automatic scaling.

backup_projects.title: College Management App
backup_projects.summary: A Django-based college management system for students, courses, and admin operations.
backup_projects.description: A comprehensive college management system built with Django. Includes student registration, course management, grade tracking, and admin dashboard for managing all operations.

backup_projects.title: Strong Password
backup_projects.summary: A Fun-Django app for generating and validating strong passwords with security metrics.
backup_projects.description: A Django-based password security tool that generates strong passwords and validates password strength. Includes security best practices, entropy calculation, and visual feedback.

learning_projects.title: ATM Machine
learning_projects.summary: A simple ATM machine simulation with account management and transactions.
learning_projects.description: A command-line ATM simulation demonstrating object-oriented programming principles, account management, and transaction handling.

learning_projects.title: Cards Stacking Animation
learning_projects.summary: Interactive card stacking animation using GSAP and JavaScript.
learning_projects.description: A demonstration of advanced animation techniques using GSAP library. Features smooth card stacking, parallax effects, and interactive elements.

learning_projects.title: Pictures Sorter
learning_projects.summary: A tool to automatically organize and sort pictures by date, name, or custom criteria.
learning_projects.description: Batch image organization tool that automatically sorts and renames pictures based on metadata, creation date, or file properties.

learning_projects.title: SpotDL Spotify Downloader
learning_projects.summary: A Spotify music downloader using SpotDL for offline listening.
learning_projects.description: A wrapper around SpotDL that simplifies downloading Spotify tracks and playlists with metadata preservation.

learning_projects.title: Instagram Downloader
learning_projects.summary: A tool to download Instagram posts, stories, and reels.
learning_projects.description: Utility for downloading Instagram content including posts, stories, and reels while preserving metadata.

learning_projects.title: Musique Player
learning_projects.summary: A web music player that streams tracks from Google Drive with playlist management and audio controls.
learning_projects.description: A React-based music player that pulls tracks from Google Drive via the Drive API. Supports playlists, playback controls, and a clean listening UI.

learning_projects.title: Hello Exam
learning_projects.summary: An online exam or quiz portal for testing and assessment.
learning_projects.description: An educational platform for creating, taking, and grading online exams and quizzes with real-time feedback.

learning_projects.title: Flash Launch
learning_projects.summary: A fast, quick search bar for the PC system (similar like windows search) but clean, and without any local search results.only with real-time internet results and more.
learning_projects.description: A desktop search launcher built with Python and OS-level integration. Type a query and it opens the default browser directly to results, with real-time suggestions.

learning_projects.title: Rush Hour
learning_projects.summary: A traffic puzzle game inspired by the classic Rush Hour board game.
learning_projects.description: An interactive Rush Hour puzzle game where players slide vehicles to clear the path. Includes multiple difficulty levels, time tracking, and a Python-backed game engine served to a React frontend.

learning_projects.title: RayFlix
learning_projects.summary: A movie discovery web app with search, details, and user data stored in MySQL.
learning_projects.description: A React-based movie app that fetches movie data from an external Movies API and persists user data (favorites, watchlist) in MySQL. Includes search, filtering, and responsive UI.

learning_projects.title: Profile Card
learning_projects.summary: A reusable profile card component for displaying user information.
learning_projects.description: A responsive profile card component showcasing user information with modern CSS styling and interactive hover effects.

learning_projects.title: Rock Paper Scissors
learning_projects.summary: A classic rock-paper-scissors game built as a Python CLI.
learning_projects.description: An interactive rock-paper-scissors game in the terminal with score tracking and a simple computer AI.
